thread:
Nora (Group PM): quick thread to align on the trial onramp playbook + what exceptions sales can grant during pilots. need final guidance by EOD.
Pri (Sales): customers hit friction converting from trial credits to a paid tier. sales want a documented process for temporary capacity increases (demo mode) and a standard ask template.
Sam (Pricing): principle: keep the funnel simple. proposal: auto-convert trial credits into a 30-day provisional commitment with a default soft cap. exceptions allowed only via a signed pilot amendment.
Dev (EngOps): operational constraints: temporary capacity = different routing (priority lane), potential quota exhaustion. we can give a time-limited token but need to throttle to avoid noisy neighbors. rough ETA: 2 engineer-weeks + feature-flag.
Pri (Sales): what's the minimum legal we need for pilots? reps need to be able to flip demo mode fast.
contracts-bot: guidance: require a one-paragraph pilot amendment: duration, explicit temporary capacity limits, auto-expiry, liability cap, and revocation rights. I can attach a draft.
Nora (Group PM): launch gates idea: (1) pilot MSA amendment in place, (2) playbook + request form for sales, (3) telemetry shows no more than 5% error rate from priority routing, (4) conversion uplift >= +2ppt vs baseline or we iterate.
Sam (Pricing): add-on decision: do not GA a paid "surge pack" until pilots validate demand. show it in UI as "Request surge" but disabled. pricing team will define SKU only after usage signals.
Dev (EngOps): feature-flag the demo tokens and the priority lane. implement per-tenant token with TTL and rate caps. ops checklist: token issuance API, Console control, alerting rule for burst errors, and rollback runbook.
Pri (Sales): request form sketch: customer name, rep, start/end time, expected peak qps, justification, and acceptance of pilot amendment terms. can legal review an SOP?
contracts-bot: uploaded draft pilot amendment to drive:link/pilot-amendment-v1 (internal). recommend approvals: sales manager + legal ops.
Nora (Group PM): decision items: Sam to publish KPI guardrails for conversion and billing complaints; Dev to share ops checklist + ETA; contracts-bot to post amendment + minimal sign-off flow; Pri to collect pilot candidates (5).
Sam (Pricing): will post KPI guardrails in this thread by 16:00.
Dev (EngOps): posting ops checklist in #eng-ops and will paste link here when live.
contracts-bot: will circulate amendment and a redlined checklist for sales.
Nora (Group PM): one more: do we allow short-term credit exchange (trade trial credits for a temporary higher soft cap)? risk: gaming. Sam?
Sam (Pricing): not at GA. can consider a controlled credit-exchange in pilot with strict audit logs and a single-use token.
Pri (Sales): fine. we'll proceed with pilot flow. PR for playbook to follow.
Nora (Group PM): thanks all. we'll reconvene after the KPI doc and pilot list. :white_check_mark:
